html:
The Class 10th board exam is considered to be an important exam in any student’s life as it sets the tone for the future. How good a student does in this exam determines his next course of action. It is also significant as it is the first board exam that is undertaken by a student in the education system.

National Talent Search Examination or NTSE, on the other hand, is a national-level exam conducted by National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT). It is only held for students of 10th standard and is conducted in two stages for granting scholarships to meritorious students.

Both, the NTSE and 10th board exam has a significant impact on the future prospects of the student. It is a nervous time for both the students and their parents. As is the case with any exam, preparation is the key to success. Here are a few tips which will ensure that you come out on top.

Get the Basics Right

Most students simply mug up the concepts and don’t bother to apply them to various problems for better understanding. It must be kept in mind that having practical knowledge will help you achieve better marks.

Make Notes

There is a lot to learn before an exam and reading lengthy chapters or carrying heavy textbooks along with you everywhere is definitely not ideal. Hence, it is important to prepare notes that contain the gist of the matter in a brief manner. Notes will ensure that you always have the important topics in hand, whenever you want to revise them.

Undertake Mock Tests

Undertaking mock tests gives you an idea of what to expect and how to go about solving the paper. Solving the previous year’s question paper is also a good way to familiarize yourself with the pattern and duration of the paper. It also gives you an understanding of the important topics that can feature in the forthcoming exam.

Study in a Group

Studying alone can be boring and tiring. On the other hand, studying with friends can be fun and interesting. Hearing your friends point of view on a particular topic can help in easier understanding of the subject. Group study sessions also help you to focus and study for long hours.

Focus on Health

Most students forget to take care of their health during exams – they sleep odd hours, don’t eat properly and take undue stress. Not taking care of your health affects your body and mind. This will have an impact on your focus and attention span. Eating healthy foods, maintaining the body’s biological clock and exercising regularly will help you perform at your best.

The time before an exam is tough for any student. Learning how to prepare correctly with a disciplined approach can make all the difference. Hopefully, with these tips you will be able to prepare in the best possible manner and get ahead of the competition.

FAQ

Which book is best for NTSE preparation?

The following are the best books for NTSE preparation:

  • Study Package For NTSE Class 10 (English) 1st & 2nd Edition
  • A Comprehensive Manual For NTSE For Class 10 (English)
  • Study Guide For NTSE National Talent Search Examination Class 10 (English)
  • Practice Test Papers For NTSE Class 10 1st Edition
  • Pearson Guide To NTSE Class 10 (English) 1st Edition
  • Target NTSE Class 10 Stage 1 & 2 Solved Papers (2015 – 19)

Can I crack NTSE in a 3-month effort?

Yes, it’s possible. However, you need to ensure that important chapters having the most weightage must be covered first, only then you should move on to the easier sections.

Is NTSE tough for class 10?

NTSE is one of the toughest scholarship exams on school level with millions of students from all over India vying for the scholarship.

How can I get full marks in NTSE?

You can get good marks in NTSE by preparing a study schedule, revising what you’ve learnt and giving as many mockup tests as possible.

When 10 th board exam will be?

The CBSE Class 10th board exam will begin on February 15, 2023 in various exam centers across the country.

What will be the pattern of board exam 2023?
